chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: First screenplays for a producer of shorts
summary: A producer of adult films talked of shorts and Spikes wrote Harlemesque; the man disappeared after marrying.

blocks.x: So when did you write your first screenplay? Because you've got five or six screenplays finished.

Yeah. Well, up there, after...after...uh... There was a white fella come along, and he was in...uh, I think, pornography, and he come up there, and he was a producer and a cameraman and all like that, and he come up there, and we got to talking about shows, and I wrote two...three of them. I got one called "Harlemesque" and one that we had made arrangements to shoot--you know, short subjects and things. He went away and got married. I never heard from him no more. And that was my first start. Anyway, my first starting was this "Rhythm Town," you see.
